command: (async () => {if(new URLSearchParams(location.search).get('examDocumentId')!=='661'||document.querySelector('.modal.show')||document.querySelector('[data-exam-judge]')?.value!=='S')throw Error('Expected clean QA661 success draft');const m=document.getElementById('examApproveModal');await new Promise((resolve,reject)=>{const timer=setTimeout(()=>reject(Error('Approval modal did not finish opening')),3500);m.addEventListener('shown.bs.modal',()=>{clearTimeout(timer);resolve();},{once:true});document.querySelector('[data-exam-approve]').click();});return {modalId:m.id,text:m.innerText};})()
